title: Berry Dessert
instructions: Grease or spray a 9x13 pan. Spread frozen fruit on bottom of pan.
Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes more, until bubbly.
story: My family isn't huge into baking, but my mom has a few really good recipes, and this is one of my favorites. As a kid, I always thought it was funny seeing my mom pour fizzy soda into a baked dessert, but the texture it creates in the finished product is really cool! As an adult, I still love this dessert because it's delicious and so easy to throw together.
